description: This file defines a Java class 'MavenWrapperDownloader' which handles downloading the Maven wrapper JAR file; it contains a main method for execution and a helper method for downloading files from URLs.

classes.name: MavenWrapperDownloader
classes.description: Main class responsible for downloading the Maven wrapper JAR, managing configuration, and performing the download.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that checks for the wrapper jar, loads configuration properties, and triggers the download.

methods.name: downloadFileFromURL
methods.description: Handles downloading a file from a specified URL to a destination File, with optional authentication via environment variables.
